messages:
Elaine (Docs): Quick sync: updating the heatmap / usage-export doc for rate & quota pages. Need confirmation on burst credit semantics and tier attribution when customers change tiers mid-window.

Elaine (Docs): Draft SDK snippet: `client.usage.export_heatmap(start=\"2026-02-01\", end=\"2026-02-28\", group_by=\"allocation_tier\", include_burst=True, prorate=False)` — should include_burst add to 'used' or show separately?

Sahil (Eng-Platform): Backend: include_burst=True aggregates burst into the 'used' column. Default is False. Attribution default = allocation at window start. There's an opt-in prorate=true which time-weights usage across tiers.

Tina (Analytics): Confirmed. Time-weighting uses seconds-per-tier in-window. When prorate=true we round prorated tokens up to nearest token in CSV reports. We use UTC for report windows.

Michael (Billing): Note: reporting view != billing view. Invoices bill committed tier per invoicing rules; adjustments handled separately. Recommend a clear billing vs reporting callout and a short side-by-side example.

Julia (DevEx): Ill add v2 SDK and curl examples, plus a tiny test. Recommend showing two CSV rows: one with allocation_at_start and one with prorate applied so readers can see the delta.

Elaine (Docs): Proposed copy: "Heatmap exports are reporting artifacts. Set include_burst=true to include burst consumption in 'used'. Tier attribution defaults to allocation at window start; set prorate=true for time-weighted attribution. Billing follows committed tiers and may differ from the export." OK?

Sahil (Eng-Platform): LGTM. Tiny nit: use `group_by=\"allocation_tier\"` in examples to avoid ambiguity. Also add behavior when both include_burst and prorate are true.

Tina (Analytics): When both flags are true we prorate burst consumption using the same time-weighting logic. Suggested CSV sample for docs: `2026-02-10,allocation_tier=pro,prorate=0.6,tokens=60000`.

Michael (Billing): :+1: Add a short example showing invoice charge vs reported usage for the same window to reduce confusion.

Elaine (Docs): I'll add the CSV samples, the billing callout, UTC note, and three snippets (v1/v2/curl). Julia, please open the PR when snippets landed.

Julia (DevEx): PR opened: https://git.internal/redwood/docs/pull/3350 — includes snippets, curl example, CSV sample rows, and a small unit test. Requesting reviews: @Sahil @Tina @Michael

Sahil (Eng-Platform): Reviewing now. One more nit: mention rounding (reported pro-rated tokens are rounded up).

Tina (Analytics): Confirmed and added to test.

Elaine (Docs): Thanks team — merging after approvals. :rocket:
